test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Grow more trees.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passive form of an imperative sentence is constructed using the phrase 'let' followed by the object and the past participle of the verb.
 
• In this case, the original sentence is 'Grow more trees.' Here, **'more trees**' is the object, and **'grown**' is the past participle of '**grow'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct passive form is 'Let more trees be grown.' 
 
• Format of imperative voice change = **Let + Subject + be + V3 + Object (if any)**

Hence, the correct passive form is **'*Let more trees be grown.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Imperative sentences are **commands, requests, or instructions.**
 
• In the passive voice, the focus is shifted from the **subject to the action itself.**
 
• Passive voice is often used to make the sentence sound more **formal** or to emphasize the action rather than the subject.
